authority: Ticket19 closed-probe framework and exact finite inventory; global Profile issuance is gated by the complete probe/operator assertion vectors, while each execution class retains its own mapping, adapter, executor, target, and replay gate

operatorContract.EQ: exact typed equality under the probe ValueType
operatorContract.ABSENT: the named observation is absent; expected must be omitted
operatorContract.SEQUENCE_EQ: exact length and exact item-by-item order equality
operatorContract.BYTES_EQ: exact byte equality against a SHA-256-bound artifact
operatorContract.WITHIN: closed rational interval comparison available only to a probe explicitly declaring host-scheduling or wall-clock observation

withinPolicy.interval: closed [minimum, maximum] with exact rational millisecond endpoints

evolutionRule: Adding, removing, or changing any probe, ValueType, boundary, operator permission, sensitivity, or execution-class membership requires a new exact Probe Profile identity.
